id: title:adamleithp:rebuild the access control panel in quill

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a UI section and panel for assigning access levels to organization members, including removal buttons and role selection, with checks for disabled states and payment gating.
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate the implementation of a Quill access control panel, including the rendering of member lists, access level selection, removal buttons, and the panel entry point. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 show the component implementation and payment gating. P1.F5.H2 and P1.F6.H1 show the tab entry and state management. This represents a substantive, bounded capability (2)
review.uncertainty: The score is assigned as 1 because the provided observations are limited to the supplied hunks, and while the implementation is visible, the broader systemic impact or complete validation across all related hunks is not supplied. The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation of a bounded capability rather than a systemic risk reduction.

observations.limitations: This chunk omits the implementation of the access control state and the QuillAccessLevelSelect, QuillAccessSection, QuillRemoveAccessButton, QuillAccessControlDefaults, QuillAccessControlRoles, QuillAccessControlMembers, QuillAccessControlObject, QuillAccessControlPanel, QuillPeopleAvatars, QuillPersonAvatar, QuillAccessLevelSelect, QuillAccessSection, QuillRemoveAccessButton, Quil

observations.behavior: Adds QuillAccessControlMembers component, which renders a list of organization members with their access levels and removal buttons, using QuillAccessLevelSelect and QuillRemoveAccessButton. It also includes a TODO for showing project admins.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a UI section to assign access levels to organization members, including a removal button and a level selector, with a note about potential race conditions when saving the whole list.

observations.behavior: Adds QuillAccessControlObject component, which renders the access control settings for an object, including a tooltip, permission warning, default access, and the members and roles sections. It also includes a PayGateMini for the access control feature and another PayGateMini for the role-based access feature.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a UI section to assign access levels to organization members, including a removal button and a level selector, with a note about potential race conditions when saving the whole list.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaces access-control removal button disabled state and tooltip with a variable disabledReason instead of canEditAccessControls.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the removal-access button behavior; the button is now disabled based on disabledReason rather than canEditAccessControls. This could affect user ability to remove access, but the implementation and checks are not supplied.

observations.behavior: Replaces tooltip text with disabledReason ?? 'Remove access' instead of conditional text based on canEditAccessControls.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes tooltip text; the tooltip now uses disabledReason ?? 'Remove access' rather than conditional text. This could affect user understanding, but the implementation and checks are not supplied.

observations.behavior: Adds a new SidePanelTab.AccessControl entry with lazyWithRetry import of QuillAccessControlPanel.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new access-control panel entry; this could enable access-control functionality, but the implementation and checks are not supplied.
